Kolkata Police Prohibits Assembly at Dharmatala Ahead of TMC Rally

Kolkata Police has imposed prohibitory orders under Section 144 in the Dharmatala area, including the Esplanade site, for 60 days. This decision comes ahead of a planned July 21 rally by the Trinamool Congress (TMC). The police cited intelligence reports of potential violent demonstrations as a reason for the order, denying permission for the rally at the designated location.
